subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should Signal groups with requireMention=true begin enforcing native mention gating whenever bot UUID or phone identity is available, even though some existing native-only groups previously passed all chatter through?
rationale: The implementation fixes an established mismatch and has strong live proof, but it intentionally changes message delivery for existing configurations and that compatibility choice belongs to the Signal maintainer.

options.title: Accept stricter gating
options.body: Treat the prior pass-through as a bug, refresh exact-head validation, and merge the documented native mention behavior.

options.title: Preserve pass-through compatibility
options.body: Pause the PR and redesign the transition so existing native-only configurations retain pass-through behavior until an explicit migration or opt-in is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter gating
recommendation.body: Treat the prior pass-through as a bug, refresh exact-head validation, and merge the documented native mention behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned official maintainer has already authored the branch's substantial follow-up fixes and is best positioned to accept the delivery-semantics tradeoff.
